verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a REST API that lets store data be created, read, updated and deleted in JSON, with a products endpoint (/wp-json/wc/v3/products). It also ships a CLI for managing stores, so programmatic catalog changes through the API half of the story are supported. However, nothing in the pack documents bulk or batch operations, CSV import/export, or bulk editing in the dashboard. missing for 10: documented CSV product import/export, batch/bulk API endpoints, admin bulk-edit UI, independent or hands-on corroboration of large catalog operations.

support.subject: As an operations lead, I can bulk import, export, and edit the catalog — CSV or API — without touching products one at a time

citations.quote: This allows WC data to be created, read, updated, and deleted using requests in JSON format
all endpoints are versioned under the /wp-json/wc/v3/ prefix (e.g. GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products)
WooCommerce CLI (WC-CLI) offers an efficient way to manage WooCommerce (WC) stores via the command line.
